description: Pull a LIVE, on-demand snapshot of a single Amazon ASIN right now — current title, price, live offers and the sellers on the listing today — and return it alongside Webotee's historical brand and seller intelligence, including the ASIN's product brand, title and price (or price range) and its fulfillment (FBA/FBM/AMZ). Use when the user gives a specific ASIN and wants its CURRENT/today's data rather than the pre-collected dataset (e.g. 'check ASIN B0... right now', 'who's on this listing today and at what price'). Every Amazon marketplace; one ASIN per call.

asin.description: The 10-character Amazon ASIN to collect live.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.

name: collect_asin_now
